name: myloc
description: Location logging, place-aware insertion, and timeline tracking

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:prod && npm run deploy:test
scripts.deploy:prod: bash -c 'source .env && [ -n "$OBSIDIAN_PLUGIN_PATH" ] && mkdir -p "$OBSIDIAN_PLUGIN_PATH" && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css "$OBSIDIAN_PLUGIN_PATH"'
scripts.deploy:test: bash -c 'source .env && [ -n "$OBSIDIAN_TEST_PLUGIN_PATH" ] && mkdir -p "$OBSIDIAN_TEST_PLUGIN_PATH" && cp main.js manifest.json styles.css "$OBSIDIAN_TEST_PLUGIN_PATH"'
